files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1859 as a large Italianate-style building known as the Lansing Block, the middle section of the building was renovated in the early 20th Century, adding Renaissance Revival-style elements to the facade.  The Lansing Block was home to the Murray House Hotel in the late 19th Century and early 20th Century prior to this renovation.
